tags.name: Rosado
tags.osm_name_note: Likely a corrupted OSM entry for 'Rosario' — every local operator lists this site as Rosario, not Rosado. Name retained as-is to preserve OSM ID integrity.
tags.validation_note: Re-audited 2026-08-11: tropical-diving.com (previously cited) did not name Rosario specifically enough to support any claim and was dropped; replaced with aquamadagascar.com, which names 'Rosario Bank' directly and adds a site-specific Rhinopias frondosa sighting and whale-shark season (Oct-Nov) corroborated independently by sakalavdiving.com.

tags.name: Chameau
tags.validation_note: Re-audited 2026-08-11: spotmydive.com (previously cited) returned HTTP 404 and was dropped; replaced with aquamadagascar.com, an independent, currently-live source. That source's own 'Camel' listing states this location is a natural formation and explicitly 'not a wreck dive,' directly conflicting with madablu.com (the operator running this site) and an independent 2013 trip report with photos, both of which describe a small sunk vessel on the northwest side. Wreck existence is therefore corroborated by 2 sources but disputed by a 3rd; flagged in markdown rather than resolved. depth corrected from 22m to 33m to match the documented high-tide/wreck route depth, which the prior value did not reflect.
